notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.7)
notes.notes:
* Fixed a bug where some walls could be penetrated.

* Fixed a bug that caused the player to be blown away in certain situations.

notes.title: Fixed（Ver 1.0.6）
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where, in certain locations (for example, very close to a bay window), you could get stuck in the terrain or be blown into the air when you got off your bike.

notes.title: Fixed（Ver 1.0.5）
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that sometimes caused you to get stuck in the terrain when you got off your bike.

notes.title: Fixed（Ver 1.0.4）
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where you could not hold a ladder etc.

notes.title: Fixed（Ver 1.0.3）
notes.notes:
The following issues have been fixed.

* Fixed an issue where the player's movement speed became faster than normal.

notes.title: Improvement updates（Ver 1.0.2）
notes.notes:
The following improvements have been made.

* Increased the speed of bicycle.

* Made it easier to notice the occurrence of certain events.

notes.title: Fixed（Ver 1.0.1）
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.

* Fixed an issue where horizontal view movement of the viewpoint was not always smooth.

* Fixed a problem where you could pass through places you shouldn't be able to pass through.
